commit.message:
Add Brewale to server implementations (#154)

Adds [Brewale](https://brewale.dev), a hosted MCP server for team skills
and conventions, to the Servers table in `docs/implementations.md`.

## Motivation and Context
Brewale implements the Skills extension
(`io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`) on its hosted MCP server. Listing it
gives host and SDK implementers another `v1` server to test against.

- Serves org, project and personal skills via `skills/list`,
`skills/get` and `resources/read`, with complete sha256 manifests
(binary files included) and `resources/directory/read`.
- Access is resolved per user: personal skills reach only their owner,
project skills follow the connection's project scope.

## How Has This Been Tested?
- Conformance suite (`@modelcontextprotocol/conformance@alpha`,
`--spec-version 2025-11-25`): `sep-2640-skills-enumeration` 30/30,
`sep-2640-skills-manifest` 6/6, `sep-2640-skills-directory` 7/7. The 2
skipped checks apply to 2026-07-28 only.
- MCP Inspector CLI: `--method skills/list --verify --require-digests`
reports no conformance errors, including a binary file's digest.

Happy to provide a test org and token so maintainers can run the
conformance suite against the hosted server.

## Breaking Changes
None. Documentation only.
